name: Securities Quote Variable
definition: Proposition of price for a financial instrument.

Qualifier.name: Qualifier
Qualifier.definition: Qualifies the use of the quote.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Indicates the scenario in which the quote is (requested to be) used (ie, indicative, firm, restricted tradeable or counter).

LegSwapType.name: Leg Swap Type
LegSwapType.definition: Indicates that the sell-side is requested to calculate the quantity based on the opposite leg and is used instead of giving a quantity.

PriceType.name: Price Type
PriceType.definition: Initiator can specify the price type the quote needs to be quoted at. If not specified, the respondent has option to specify how quote is quoted.

QuoteTradingSession.name: Quote Trading Session
QuoteTradingSession.definition: Details of a specific trading session associated with a quote.

MidSide.name: Mid Side
MidSide.definition: Indicates that the quote details are indicated as a mid of a security, commodity, currency (an average of the offer and the bid).

BidSide.name: Bid Side
BidSide.definition: Indicates that the quote details are indicated as a bid of a security, commodity, currency.

OfferSide.name: Offer Side
OfferSide.definition: Indicates that the quote details are indicated as an offer of a security, commodity, currency.

RelatedQuote.name: Related Quote
RelatedQuote.definition: Quote parameters related to a security quote.

SecuritiesOrder.name: Securities Order
SecuritiesOrder.definition: Preliminary information on conditions of the order, specified in the quote (request).
